title: Open Values Pulse v0.1
description: The list of recent changes to the catalogue: facts files and guides added or corrected, and facts files with sources old enough to need checking again. The site's build writes it from git history.

format.description: Always "ovs-pulse". Tells a reader that this file is the list of recent changes to the catalogue.

version.description: The version of the pulse format this file follows, 0.1.

built.description: The day the file was built, as YYYY-MM-DD.

windowDays.description: How many days of history the file looks back over, such as 90.

entries.description: The recent changes, newest first, up to a fixed limit (120 in the current builder).

truncated.description: How many further changes were left out because the list hit its limit. 0 means nothing was left out.

date.description: The day of the change, as YYYY-MM-DD. For a stale entry it is the day the file was built.

node.description: What changed, as an id such as "ovs:cat/banking" for a facts file or "ovs:guide/ethical-banking" for a guide.

kind.description: What happened. "added" is a new file, "corrected" is a change to an existing one, and "stale" means some of its sources are old enough to need checking again (two years for fast-changing categories, three for the rest). "contested" is allowed but the current builder does not write it.

what.description: One sentence saying what changed, shown in the What's new list.

source.description: For a stale entry: the web address of the oldest source that needs checking.

commit.description: The first 8 characters of the git commit that made the change, so a reader can look it up.
